days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 month he has been complaining of generalised weakness. Since 15 days he has been feeling cold(even though it is summer) and has been switching off all the fans in the house.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe has been suffering with constipation since 10 days. Has not passed stools at all(confirmed by the attender) He did not take any medication for it\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe also complained of abdominal distension\/bloating due to not passing stools.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 week he has fever insidious in onset gradually progressive, high grade. Associated with body pains.Not Associated with chills and rigor. Not relieved with medication.Not associated with nausea, vomiting, burning micturition, headache.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 3 days -he fell in the washroom two times(on 22\/5\/1023)and was not able to get up. When his family members found him, he had slurring of speech and altered sensorium.They took him to the Nalgonda government hospital.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere they gave him an enema and his constipation and bloating was relieved immediately.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey also treated him symptomatically. But he was still in altered sensorium and did not cover\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey then shifted him to a private hospital as they had contacts there. The sputum AFB\u0026nbsp; is done in the March and it is negative .\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESo they gave cough relievers, but her cough is relieving only when she is taking medication but not subsided completely.so they came to our OPD.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o weight loss since 2 months.
